title: Assessing the Aesthetic Evaluation Capabilities of GPT-4 with Vision: Insights from Group and Individual Assessments
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the aesthetic sensibility of GPT-4 with Vision specifically regarding image quality and beauty. While it briefly mentions that humans perceive beauty in 'moral behaviors', the actual experimental work and benchmarking are strictly limited to the visual aesthetics of images and do not involve religion, morals, or ethics.
